description: Rich handcrafted ice cream.

name: Myrto
description: Cosy café with homemade cakes and pies in Vamos village.

name: Zamāna by Domes
description: New (2025) Domes beach bar and restaurant on Aptera beach, with barefoot luxury, sunbeds, DJs, crafted cocktails and chef-led food. Open to the public.
address: Apteron road, Kon/nou Paleologou, Chania 731 00, Greece

name: Onar Seaside Lounge
description: New high-investment beach lounge on Loutraki beach, Akrotiri, with boho bamboo design, sunbeds and lounges, signature cocktails, sushi, DJ sets and events.

name: Cabana Mare Beach Club
description: Chania's biggest, busiest beach club, with sunbeds, private jacuzzis, DJs and parties. Pricey.

name: Ammos & Ilios Beach Bar
description: Agia Marina institution since 1997, a beach bar and restaurant from morning to night, with DJ parties.

name: Almira Beach Bar Restaurant
description: Large organised beach bar and restaurant. Sunbeds are free with consumption, and it suits families.

name: Rodakino Beach Bar
description: Popular beach bar on the main Agia Marina strand facing Thodorou island – lively in high summer.

name: Menta Beach Bar - Restaurant
description: All-day beach bar on Maleme beach with tamarisk shade, sunbeds, coffee, cocktails and food from breakfast to dinner.

name: Neromylos beach & pool bar
description: Platanias' classic beach bar on the sand, with a pool and summer vibes. A long-time favourite.

name: Macaya Beach House
description: Trendy beach house on Falasarna's big beach, with sunbeds, a pool, cocktails and the sunset.

name: Liokalyvo Beach Bar
description: Well-known beach bar and beach club on Falasarna big beach, with sunbeds, cocktails, music and sunsets.

name: Orange Blue Bar
description: Relaxed café-snack bar on the quieter northern end of Falasarna beach, with sunbeds and a front-row seat for the famous sunset.

name: Bird Away Beach Bar Restaurant
description: All-day beach bar on Falasarna big beach with signature cocktails, sunbeds on the sand, music and sunsets.

name: Beach Bar Cafe Frangokastello
description: Laid-back beach bar on Frangokastello’s sandy shore with views of the Venetian castle – beers, drinks and simple plates.

name: Vanilla Beach Bar
description: Polished beach bar on the eastern stretch of Georgioupoli beach – sunbeds around €7, good music and food, family-friendly.

name: Sun Kiss beach bar
description: Beach bar by the river mouth on Georgioupoli beach – coffee in the morning, lunch, then a sundowner beer.

name: BLUE BOAT Beach Bar
description: A 28-year Georgioupoli institution on the long sandy beach – island décor, fair prices and complimentary raki.

name: KOHILI BEACH BAR
description: Kalyves’ favourite beach bar, from breakfast by the water to sunset drinks, with well-made food.

name: Seitan Limania Beach
description: A dramatic fjord-like cove of turquoise water between sheer cliffs; a steep 10-minute scramble down, no shade or facilities.

name: Marathi Beach
description: Two sheltered sandy coves on Souda Bay lined with fish tavernas – calm, shallow water ideal for kids.

name: Stavros Beach
description: Shallow, almost enclosed lagoon below the mountain from the film “Zorba the Greek” – ideal for small children.

name: Chrissi Akti (Golden Beach)
description: The best sandy beach on Chania’s doorstep (3 km west): organised, shallow and tamarisk-shaded.

name: Agia Marina Beach
description: Long organised sandy beach facing Thodorou island, with every watersport and plenty of beach bars.

name: Balos Lagoon
description: Crete’s most photographed lagoon: shallow turquoise water and pink-white sand below the Gramvousa peninsula. Reach it by boat from Kissamos or by a dirt road plus a 20-minute walk down (steep back up).

name: Falasarna Beach
description: Falasarna’s long golden-sand beach, famous for its sunsets – partly organised, shallow and great for families.

name: Gramvousa Beach
description: The beach of Imeri Gramvousa island, with its shipwreck and Venetian fortress above – reached only on the Balos boat cruises from Kissamos.

name: Menies Beach
description: Wild cove at the tip of the Rodopou peninsula beside the ancient sanctuary of Diktynna – 15 km of dirt road, crystal-clear water.

name: Sfinari Beach
description: Quiet pebble beach on the wild west coast with a few tavernas and fine sunsets, far from the Falasarna crowds.

name: Mavros Molos Beach
description: Clean sand-and-shingle beach on the western edge of Kissamos, next to the remains of the ancient harbour.

name: Kedrodasos Beach
description: A wild cove framed by ancient junipers 1 km east of Elafonisi – crystal-clear water, no facilities; dirt road plus a short walk (or the E4 path from Elafonisi).

name: Gialiskari Beach (Anydri)
description: Pine-shaded pebble cove where the Anydri gorge meets the sea, 3 km east of Paleochora – canteen and natural shade.

name: Grammeno Beach
description: A cedar-covered headland with two coves – one is always sheltered from the wind; pebbles, clear water, 5 km west of Paleochora.

name: Krios Beach
description: Long shingle beach west of Paleochora with clear shallow water and tamarisk shade, rarely crowded.

name: Elafonisi Beach
description: Crete’s famous pink-sand lagoon with a wadeable islet; shallow, warm water perfect for kids. Very busy in summer – arrive early.

name: Sougia Beach
description: A kilometre of grey pebbles and deep-blue water in the laid-back south-coast village of Sougia.

name: Pachia Ammos Beach (Paleochora)
description: Paleochora’s town sandy beach – organised, shallow, family-friendly and a classic windsurf spot.

name: Glyka Nera (Sweetwater) Beach
description: “Sweetwater” beach – fresh-water springs seep through the pebbles under the cliffs; pines and turquoise water. Boat or 1-hour walk from Chora Sfakion.

name: Ilingas Beach
description: Small turquoise pebble cove just west of Chora Sfakion, with sunbeds and a beach bar.

name: Marmara Beach
description: A white-marble cove with sea caves at the mouth of the Aradena gorge – superb snorkelling; boat or walk from Loutro.

name: Orthi Ammos Beach
description: Steep “upright sand” dunes and shallow warm water just east of Frangokastello castle.

name: Domata Beach
description: Remote pebble beach between Agia Roumeli and Sougia, reachable only by boat or on foot – pristine, clear water.

name: Agios Pavlos Beach (Sfakia)
description: Dune-backed beach beside the tiny Byzantine chapel of Agios Pavlos, 1.5 hours east of Agia Roumeli on the E4 path – one of Sfakia’s wildest spots.
address: Monop. Agia Roumeli - Samaria, Sfakia 730 11, Greece

name: Frangokastello Beach
description: Shallow, lagoon-like sandy beach right below the Venetian castle – ideal for small children.

name: Kalyvaki Beach
description: Sheltered sandy cove at the northern end of Georgioupoli with calm water for children.

name: Kalyves Beach
description: Long sandy beach in front of Kalyves village with shallow water, beach bars and tavernas.

name: Kiani Akti Beach
description: Quiet sand-and-pebble cove beneath Itzedin fortress on Souda Bay.

name: Almyrida Beach
description: Shallow sandy bay in the pretty fishing village of Almyrida – organised, with watersports and dive centres.

name: Georgioupoli Beach
description: Georgioupoli’s huge sandy beach running ~10 km towards Kavros – beach bars and watersports; mind the currents on windy days.

name: Tripiti Beach (Gavdos)
description: The southernmost point of Europe, with its pierced rock arch and a small crystal-clear cove.

name: Potamos Beach (Gavdos)
description: Remote northern Gavdos beach reached only on foot (~40 minutes) or by boat, with crystal-clear water.

name: Agios Ioannis Beach (Gavdos)
description: Wide juniper-and-dune beach in north Gavdos, legendary for its free-spirited camping scene.

name: Sarakiniko Beach (Gavdos)
description: Gavdos’ main sandy beach with dunes and junipers near the Karave port – Europe’s southernmost island.

name: Grand Arsenal (Venetian Shipyards / Neoria)
description: The Grand Arsenal on the Venetian harbour, a rebuilt shipyard housing the Center for Mediterranean Architecture with exhibitions and events, next to the seven surviving Venetian shipyards.
address: Grand Arsenal, Michail Afentoulief, Chania 731 32, Greece

name: Old Venetian Harbour of Chania
description: The 14th-century Venetian harbour with its lighthouse, Ottoman mosque and arsenals – the heart of Chania; walk the breakwater to the lighthouse at sunset.

name: Chania Lighthouse
description: The Venetian-Egyptian lighthouse (16th/19th c.) at the end of the harbour breakwater – a 1.5 km stroll with the best view back over the town.

name: Maritime Museum of Crete
description: Crete’s maritime history museum in the Firkas fortress – ship models, the Battle of Crete and a full-size replica Minoan ship nearby.

name: Mosque of Kioutsouk Hasan (Yali Mosque)
description: The domed Yali (Kioutsouk Hasan) Mosque of 1645 on the harbour front – Crete’s oldest Ottoman building, now used for exhibitions.

name: Firkas Fortress
description: The Venetian fortress guarding the harbour mouth, where the Greek flag was raised in 1913; it houses the Maritime Museum.

name: Cathedral of Chania (Trimartyri)
description: The Metropolitan Cathedral of the Presentation of the Virgin (Trimartyri, 1860) on Cathedral Square in the heart of the old town.

name: Etz Hayyim Synagogue
description: Crete's only surviving synagogue, a restored Romaniote synagogue in the old Jewish quarter, with historian-led tours.

name: Folklore Museum of Chania
description: Small folklore museum in a courtyard house on Chalidon Street, with tools, weavings and scenes of traditional Cretan life.

name: Venizelos Graves
description: The tombs of Eleftherios Venizelos and his son on Profitis Ilias hill, with a panoramic view over Chania – a great sunset spot.

name: Souda Bay War Cemetery
description: The immaculate Commonwealth War Cemetery on Souda Bay – a moving memorial to the 1941 Battle of Crete.

name: Museum of Typography (Garedakis)
description: A unique printing museum with working presses from Gutenberg’s era onwards – guides print in front of you; loved by older kids too.
address: 03, Park of Local Industries Building 13, Souda 732 00, Greece

name: Agios Nikolaos Church (Splantzia)
description: 14th-century church on Splantzia square, once a Dominican monastery and later a mosque. The only church in Greece with both a bell tower and a minaret.

name: Archaeological Museum of Chania
description: The new, state-of-the-art Archaeological Museum of Chania in Chalepa, with finds from Minoan to Roman western Crete.

name: Eleftherios Venizelos House Museum
description: The beautifully preserved Chalepa home of statesman Eleftherios Venizelos, with original furnishings and engaging guided visits.
address: Oikia - Mouseio Elevtheriou Venizelou, Pl. Elenas Venizelou, Chania 731 33, Greece

name: Chrysopigi Monastery
description: A historic 16th-century convent on the edge of town, with an ecclesiastical museum and icon workshops kept by the nuns.

name: Agia Triada Tzagarolon Monastery
description: The striking 17th-century Venetian-style monastery on Akrotiri, set among vineyards and olive groves; the monks’ wine and oil can be tasted next door.

name: Gouverneto Monastery
description: Fortified 16th-century monastery on northern Akrotiri – starting point of the path down to the Katholiko ruins.

name: Katholiko Monastery & Cave
description: Ruins of one of Crete’s oldest monasteries (11th c.) built into a ravine, with the cave of St John the Hermit – a 20–30 minute walk down from Gouverneto.

name: Gonia Monastery (Odigitria)
description: The 17th-century Odigitria Gonia monastery by the sea at Kolymbari, with a fine icon collection and sea views.

name: German War Cemetery of Maleme
description: The German war cemetery on Hill 107 above Maleme airfield, a key site of the 1941 Battle of Crete, with views over the bay.

name: Gramvousa Fortress
description: A 1579 Venetian fortress crowning Imeri Gramvousa island, later a pirate and rebel base – a 20-minute climb from the Balos boats with a view over the lagoon.

name: Archaeological Museum of Kissamos
description: Housed in the Venetian governor’s palace, with superb Roman mosaics from ancient Kissamos and finds from Polyrrhenia and Falasarna.

name: Acropolis of Polyrrhenia
description: The hilltop acropolis of ancient Polyrrhenia above Kissamos – walls, rock-cut cisterns and a sweeping view of the whole gulf.

name: Ancient Lissos
description: The ancient healing sanctuary of Asclepius with mosaic floors in a secluded cove – a 1.5-hour hike from Sougia or by boat.
address: Epar.Od. Chanion - Sougias, Kandanos Selinos 730 09, Greece

name: Chrysoskalitissa Monastery
description: A whitewashed convent perched on a rock above the Libyan Sea, with the legend of the “golden step” – an easy stop on the way to Elafonisi.

name: Askyfou War Museum
description: A passionate private collection of weapons and memorabilia from the Cretan revolts to the 1941 Battle of Crete – a fascinating stop on the road to Sfakia.

name: Frangokastello Castle
description: Venetian fortress from 1371–74 right on Frangokastello beach, home of the Drosoulites legend. Easy to pair with a swim.

name: Ancient Aptera
description: One of Crete’s major ancient city-states: theatre, huge Roman cisterns and walls, with sweeping views over Souda Bay; the Ottoman Koules fort is next door.

name: Historical Folklore Museum of Gavalochori
description: Folklore museum in a Venetian-Ottoman mansion in picturesque Gavalochori, telling village history through crafts and everyday objects.

name: Monastery of Agios Georgios Karydi
description: Venetian-era monastery among olive groves near Vamos, with an impressive old stone olive press and cells.

name: Sinagogi Cocktail Bar
description: Chania's iconic cocktail bar in a ruined synagogue courtyard, open till 4am.

name: To Monastiri tou Karolou
description: Cocktail bar in a Venetian building on Daliani, Splantzia's bar street.

name: Fagotto Jazz Bar
description: The city's jazz bar, with live music in a stone space by the harbour.

name: Bras de Frères
description: Lively bar with karaoke, theme nights and concerts.

name: Melodica Cocktail Bar
description: One of the trendiest creative cocktail bars in the old town lanes.

name: Elli Music Bar
description: Music bar right on the harbour, with dancing and cocktails with a view.

name: THRI / THREE
description: Much-loved bar on Sarpidonos, the bar lane behind the harbour.

name: Boulevard of Broken Dreams
description: Legendary old-town rock bar.

name: Momentum Chania
description: New, much-loved cocktail bar with a yard on Kallergon, by the old port (5.0).

name: DNA Night Club
description: Central Chania club on Sourmeli by the harbour: Latin and mainstream music, entry includes a drink.

name: Garage Club
description: Club set in the Venetian moat of the old town (entrance off Chalidon) with well-known DJs. Packed every summer.

name: Lime Sips & Bites
description: Cocktail bar on lively Daliani street in Splantzia, with a perfect rating.

name: Vermuteria
description: Busy vermouth bar on Splantzia square (1821 Sq.): vermouth, low-ABV cocktails, Cretan wines and small plates.

name: Manteio Cocktail Bar
description: Cocktail and music bar on Platanias main street: strong cocktails and a lively night atmosphere.

name: Eclipse Bar Platanias
description: Bar-club on Platanias square, where the crowds gather at night: cocktails, DJs and shisha.
address: Eclipse Bar Platanias Square, Platanias 730 14, Greece

name: Merlin Bar
description: One of Platanias' favourite party bars, with parties and cocktails.

name: Kahlua Cocktail Bar
description: Friendly cocktail bar with a balcony in Agia Marina, 80s music.

name: Agios Bar
description: Paleochora's classic bar for 30 years, in the old bus station, with crafted cocktails.

name: Splendid by Dimitris
description: The best cocktail bar in Georgioupoli (4.9).

name: Agia Triada Tzagarolon Wine Cellar
description: The cellar shop of Agia Triada monastery – taste the monastery’s own wines and olive oil.
address: Moni Agias Triados ton Tzagkarolon 731 00, Greece

name: Patriotis Winery
description: Boutique family winery of the Stylianoudakis family in Vouves (near the ancient olive tree) with personal tours.

name: Karavitakis Winery
description: Fourth-generation family winery with a tasting room and patio – native Cretan varieties paired with local cheeses.

name: PoTolo Tasting Experiences
description: Organic wine and extra-virgin olive oil tasting experiences in a mountain village above Kissamos, run by a young team.

name: Pnevmatikakis Winery
description: Long-established winery near Kissamos offering tours through every stage of production and tastings.

name: Dourakis Winery
description: Award-winning solar-powered winery (since 1988) in Alikampos with a tasting terrace and restaurant, open daily.

name: Stemfilo Winery Paterakis
description: Family winery since 1983 in mountain scenery south of Chania, pouring native varieties with small bites.
address: Maravegiana Eparch.odos, Epar.Od. Katochoriou-Kampou, Chania 731 00, Greece

name: Loupakis Winery
description: Hilltop estate offering vineyard walks and tastings with a panoramic view.

name: Mavres Winery
description: Small family agro-winery 16 km from Chania, with tastings accompanied by home-made snacks.

name: Giakoumakis Winery
description: Family winery in Perivolia, ten minutes from town, with warm hospitality.

name: Anoskeli Winery
description: Family estate producing wine and olive oil, with wine and oil tastings in a shady courtyard.

name: Manousakis Winery (Nostos)
description: Home of the acclaimed Nostos wines in the foothills of the White Mountains – cellar tour and tasting (around €15 for five wines).

name: Marathi Watersports
description: Watersports at Marathi – jet ski, inflatables, SUP and kayaks on calm Souda Bay.

name: Cactus Beach Water Sports
description: Agia Marina’s top watersports centre – jet ski, parasailing, inflatables and SUP.

name: Splish Splash Water Sports
description: Watersports on Agia Marina beach (by Alexia Beach) – jet ski, inflatables and parasailing.
address: Alexia Beach Hotel, Next to, Ag. Marina 730 14, Greece

name: Surfing Crete
description: Surf and SUP school with lessons and surf trips around Chania’s beaches – family-friendly.

name: Surf Island Kalamaki
description: Surf Island station on Kalamaki beach: surf, windsurf and SUP lessons and rentals in shallow water.

name: Salty Adventure Jet Ski & Watersports
description: Jet ski safaris and watersports in Platanias with outstanding reviews.

name: Platanias Watersports
description: Platanias beach watersports, known for parasailing, with great reviews for safety and photos.

name: Chania Surf Club
description: Surf and SUP school on Chrissi Akti, with lessons for all ages when the waves are up.

name: Kissamos Rent a Boat & Sea Sports
description: Jet ski and sea sports on Kissamos beach (also licence-free boat hire).

name: Surf Island Falassarna
description: Falasarna’s well-known surf centre – lessons and rental for surf, SUP and windsurf.

name: Falassarna Activities
description: Watersports on Falasarna’s big beach – inflatables, SUP and kayaks.

name: Aquaholics Elafonisi
description: Water activities at Elafonisi – SUP, kayaks and snorkelling in the lagoon.

name: The Wind Tribe Crete
description: Windsurf and wing-foil school at Elafonisi, one of Crete’s best wind spots.
address: Elafonisi beach Elafonisi, Kandanos Selinos 730 04, Greece

name: Water Sports Paleochora
description: Paleochora watersports: jet ski and towables. The only classic beach watersports centre on the south coast with recent reviews.

name: Almyrida Summer Sports
description: Beach watersports centre in Almyrida: jet ski, towables, SUP, kayak, windsurf and catamaran rental.

name: Leo's Water Sports
description: Georgioupoli beach watersports centre (Mare Monte): parasailing, jet ski, towables, water ski, wakeboard, SUP and canoe.
address: Mare Monte Beach Hotel, Georgioupoli 730 07, Greece

name: Coastline Sea Experiences Watersports
description: Georgioupoli watersports: jet ski rental, towables, water ski, wakeboard, SUP and kayak.

name: ELPISNIKI Park
description: A 13-acre outdoor play park with a “Survivor” adventure course, pitches, café and food.

name: Chania Municipal Garden
description: The historic 1870 Municipal Garden with a playground, a small enclosure of Cretan kri-kri goats, clock tower and café – a shady family oasis in town.

name: Mikrofyies Indoor Playground
description: Chania’s most popular indoor play centre – the go-to on a rainy day.

name: Square Cafe Playground
description: Playground café at Profitis Ilias (Akrotiri): clean, well-kept play area with attentive staff and food for parents.

name: Rocky Pass Mini Golf
description: Rock-and-waterfall themed mini golf in Kato Stalos, open late into the evening.

name: Kostas Fun Park Mini Golf & Mini Cars
description: Mini golf plus a mini-car track for kids aged 3–14 in Kolymbari.
address: Avra Imperial Hotel, Kolymbari, next to, Kolimvari 730 06, Greece

name: Atlantis Glow Golf
description: Indoor glow-in-the-dark mini golf in Platanias – fun on a rainy day too.

name: Happyland Kissamos
description: Top-rated indoor play centre in Kissamos – the rainy-day answer in the far west.

name: Dousakis Honey Beekeeping Tours
description: Family bee farm in Rodopou: learn how bees live and taste 15 bee, olive and goat-milk products – a stop on the way to Menies beach.

name: Arevitis Farm Experience
description: An authentic Cretan farm experience with animals and hands-on activities for all ages; visits by appointment only.

name: Rainbow Playground-Cafe-Minigolf
description: Playground, mini golf and café in Georgioupoli – parents relax while kids play.

name: Limnoupolis Water Park
description: Chania’s big water park (Aqua Creta Limnoupolis) with slides for every age and toddler pools, 8 km from town.

name: PistaPark Go-Kart
description: Modern go-kart track next to Limnoupolis, with kids’ karts and double karts for parent and child.

name: Botanical Park & Gardens of Crete
description: A huge hillside botanical park reborn after a 2003 fire: a 2.5 km trail past tropical fruit trees, animals and a lake, plus a farm-to-table restaurant – a family favourite.
